name: Mean People
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of mean and wicked people, reminding us that even the wicked serve God's purposes (Proverbs 16:4). It warns against forming close relationships with angry or furious individuals (Proverbs 22:24) and reveals that hidden hatred and deceit will ultimately be exposed (Proverbs 26:26). In response to mistreatment, believers are called to bless and pray for those who curse or spitefully use them (Luke 6:28), offering their lives as holy sacrifices in obedience to God's mercies (Romans 12:1). This teaches a Christ-centered approach of grace and holiness amid the challenge of mean people.
